patterns.name: Down on every beat
patterns.tip: The steadiest pattern there is. Count 1 2 3 4 and strum on each number.

patterns.name: Down-up eighths
patterns.tip: The hand never stops: down on the numbers, up on the “and”.

patterns.name: Folk
patterns.tip: Keep the hand moving on the missing strums (2 “and” … 3): the rhythm stays even.

patterns.name: Pop push
patterns.tip: Two down strums, then the ups carry the end of the bar forward.

patterns.name: Rock eighths
patterns.tip: All downstrokes, short and even. Mute with the palm for a tighter sound.

patterns.name: Slow ballad
patterns.tip: One long strum, then a light push at the end of the bar.

patterns.name: Offbeat chop
patterns.tip: Only the “and” of each beat: short upstrokes, then lift the pressure so the chord stops.

patterns.name: Charleston
patterns.tip: Beat 1 and the “and” of 2. The space is part of the pattern.

patterns.name: Waltz
patterns.tip: Three beats per bar: lean a little on the first one.

patterns.name: Waltz with ups
patterns.tip: Beat 1 alone, then down-up on 2 and 3.

patterns.name: Six-eight sway
patterns.tip: Two big pulses per bar, each split in three. Feel it as 1-2-3 4-5-6.
